title: Increase in Water Seepage Issues in HDB Flats and Adequacy of Staff Assigned to Rectify These Issues
what_it_is: Increase in Water Seepage Issues in HDB Flats and Adequacy of Staff Assigned to Rectify These Issues

sections.label: HDB water seepage cases 2024
sections.summary: In 2024, HDB assisted Town Councils and flat owners with 859 complex water seepage cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In 2024, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) assisted Town Councils (TCs) and flat owners with a total of 859 complex water seepage cases.

sections.label: No March 2025 surge
sections.summary: Based on cases HDB received, it did not observe a surge in March 2025.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Based on the number of cases that HDB received, it did not observe a surge in March 2025.

sections.label: Ceiling leak repair assistance
sections.summary: HDB pays 50% of ceiling leak repair cost under the Goodwill Repair Assistance scheme, with the rest shared by flat owners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: HDB assists flat owners in resolving ceiling leaks through the Goodwill Repair Assistance scheme, where HDB pays 50% of the ceiling leak repair cost, while the remaining 50% is shared equally between the upper- and lower-floor flat owners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: For example, HDB is working with industry partners and research institutes to develop better ways to address maintenance issues, especially those encountered in our older estates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: This includes an ongoing trial at 70 flats island-wide on the use of better scanning technology which has the capability to scan through concrete to detect causes of seepage.

sections.label: Methods for wall seepage
sections.summary: HDB has been introducing tested and proven methods, such as the Corrosion Resistant Repair method, for wall seepage cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: What HDB has been doing aside from leaning forward to assist TCs where there are long-standing or difficult-to-resolve cases, is we have also been introducing methods that have been tested and proven to be effective in dealing with wall seepage cases, such as the Corrosion Resistant Repair method.

sections.label: TC staff and re-roofing
sections.summary: This helps TC staff understand water seepage causes, and TCs have continued re-roofing with Government funding and S&CCs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: This is to help TC staff better understand what are some of the possible causes of water seepage and we also hope that this would equip them with more information when making a decision on which contractors to engage.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And as for the issue of re-roofing, to date, our experience with TCs across the board is that they have been able to continue to do re-roofing based on the funding support that they have received from the Government, but also from the service and conservancy charges (S&CCs) that they have been collecting from residents.

sections.label: Solar panels and seepage
sections.summary: If TCs think rooftop solar panels could affect insulation and seepage, installing contractors would work with TC and HDB.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: If the TCs are of the view that solar panels deployed on the rooftops of HDB blocks could possibly affect insulation and therefore, affect seepage, then this is something which, in our experience, the contractors that have been responsible for installing the solar panels would work very closely with TC and also with HDB, if necessary, to resolve the issue.
